nodes.name: autofix.js
nodes.summary: CLI that reads the test runner's _stream.jsonl findings and auto-generates safe dark-mode CSS rules (font contrast fixes and optional stuck-white container fixes), inserting them into style.css after the dark-mode marker with a .bak-autofix backup, and writes autofix_report.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Aggregates per-page findings by selector|color key, generalizes selectors (strips dynamic IDs, drops bare tags), and only applies fixes that are not HUD/overlay or SVG/MathJax/Plotly elements; supports --dry-run and --only-critical.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: validates stream/CSS paths, aggregates font issues and optional stuck-white clusters from _stream.jsonl, filters to safe fixes, renders the CSS block, inserts it into style.css at the dark-mode marker (with backup), and writes the report.

nodes.name: generalizeSelector
nodes.summary: Strips dynamic IDs and collapses duplicate classes from a CSS selector so many element-specific findings collapse into one rule; returns null for bare-tag selectors that are too broad to fix automatically.

nodes.name: groupByGeneralized
nodes.summary: Groups candidate fixes by their generalized selector, merging the affected pages and counting original element occurrences, and collects the bare-tag selectors that were skipped as needing manual fixes.

nodes.name: findDarkMarker
nodes.summary: Locates the insertion point in style.css: a /* ...darkmode... */ comment or the first html.dark rule, falling back to end-of-file, so generated rules land in the dark-mode section.

nodes.name: writeReport
nodes.summary: Writes autofix_report.json into the output dir, recording applied rules (selector, new/old color, severity, contrast, page list), stuck-white fixes, and the skipped unsafe fixes.

nodes.name: github-actions.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow ('Dark-mode check') triggered on pushes/PRs touching darkmode-ci/**, style.css, or PHP lessons: installs Chromium + php-cli, serves the blog on :8080, runs test.js with configurable wait/parallel/pages inputs, uploads screenshots, posts a PR summary comment, and exits non-zero when bugs are found.

nodes.name: bug-detector.js
nodes.summary: Detection core: matches light/dark element snapshots pairwise and flags theme-switch bugs (bg+color unchanged on a still-light dark background), WCAG AA font-readability violations, and stuck-white pixel clusters, skipping HUD, accents, backdrop, and math/plot elements.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports the shared constants DARK_PAGE_BG and the intentional indigo ACCENT_COLORS allowlist used to suppress false positives.

nodes.name: matchPairs
nodes.summary: Greedy nearest-neighbor matching of light and dark snapshot elements by identical selector within a 5px Manhattan distance, producing {light, dark} pairs for comparison.

nodes.name: detectThemeBugs
nodes.summary: Reports element pairs whose background and color barely changed between themes but whose dark background is still light (luminance > 0.7), with severity 'critical' (lum > 0.9) or 'warning', filtering out accents, HUD, backdrop, and tiny elements.

nodes.name: detectFontIssues
nodes.summary: Computes WCAG contrast of each text-bearing dark-mode element against its effective background (falling back to the dark page bg when transparent) and reports violations: severity critical (<2), bad (2-3), warn (3-4.5), or tiny-font (<11px text).

nodes.name: detectBlock
nodes.summary: Async orchestrator for one scroll block: runs matchPairs + detectThemeBugs + detectFontIssues on the snapshots and findStuckWhiteClusters on the two PNGs, returning {bugs, fontIssues, whiteClusters}.

nodes.name: color-utils.js
nodes.summary: Shared color math: parses rgb()/rgba() strings, computes WCAG 2.x relative luminance and contrast ratio, RGB distance, luminance bands, and picks a readable light foreground color against a dark background.

nodes.name: parseRgba
nodes.summary: Parses an rgb()/rgba() CSS color string into {r,g,b,a} (alpha defaults to 1), returning null on malformed input; the entry point for all color comparisons.

nodes.name: relLum
nodes.summary: Computes WCAG 2.x relative luminance from an {r,g,b} object using the sRGB linearization threshold (0.03928) and the 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722 channel weights.

nodes.name: contrastRatio
nodes.summary: Computes the WCAG contrast ratio (Lmax+0.05)/(Lmin+0.05) between two parsed colors; the metric behind all font-readability thresholds.

nodes.name: pickReadableForeground
nodes.summary: Walks a list of safe light colors and returns the first whose contrast against the given dark background meets the minimum (default 4.5), used by autofix to choose replacement text colors.

nodes.name: element-snapshot.js
nodes.summary: Puppeteer page.evaluate helpers that capture every visible element's computed style (bg, color, font size, backdrop) and bounding rect as a flat snapshot, or identify the element under a given viewport point, with SVG/MathJax/Plotly tags skipped.
nodes.languageNotes: The skip-tag lists are re-inlined inside the page.evaluate closures because Node-side helpers are not visible in the browser context.

nodes.name: snapshotVisibleElements
nodes.summary: Captures up to maxElements (default 800) visible in-viewport elements as {sel, ancSel, bg, color, fontSize, hasText, backdrop, inlineBg/inlineColor, x,y,w,h} records built from getBoundingClientRect + getComputedStyle, skipping hidden, low-opacity, SVG, and math/plot nodes.

nodes.name: identifyElementAtPoint
nodes.summary: Uses document.elementsFromPoint to find the first meaningful element (skipping html/body/SVG) at viewport coordinates and returns its selector, colors, snippet of text, and positioning info — used to label stuck-white clusters.

nodes.name: pixel-diff.js
nodes.summary: PNG pixel-level comparison: builds difference masks between light and dark screenshots of the same block, then flood-fills them into bounding-box clusters to find stuck-white regions (white in both themes) and strongly changed regions.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles the pngjs 6.x vs 7.x sync-read API move by detecting PNG.PNG.sync once at load time.

nodes.name: findStuckWhiteClusters
nodes.summary: Masks pixels that are near-white (avg > whiteThreshold, default 235) in both light and dark screenshots with low color difference, then returns flood-filled clusters (default min 800 px, aspect-ratio capped) — the visual confirmation of theme-switch bugs.

nodes.name: findChangedClusters
nodes.summary: Masks pixels whose light/dark RGB sum-difference exceeds minDifference (default 100) and flood-fills them into clusters (default min 500 px), highlighting regions that did switch between themes.

nodes.name: floodClusters
nodes.summary: Iterative 4-neighborhood flood-fill over a binary mask collecting bounding boxes and pixel counts per cluster, filtering by minimum size, minimum extent, and maximum aspect ratio.

nodes.name: scroll-capture.js (lib)
nodes.summary: Generic Puppeteer scroll-and-screenshot library (ScrollCapture class): launches Chromium, opens isolated browser contexts, navigates with module-loader wait, scrolls in fixed steps with double-rAF settle, and captures screenshots + DOM snapshots per position in one or both themes.
nodes.languageNotes: Each page gets its own BrowserContext for cookie/storage isolation; scrollTo waits two requestAnimationFrame ticks to fix the pre-paint screenshot race.

nodes.name: ScrollCapture
nodes.summary: Core reusable capture engine: launch/close, openPage (isolated context), navigate (theme cookie + networkidle2 + _modulesLoaded wait), scrollTo (double-rAF), computeScrollPositions, captureAt (per-position, multi-theme, optional snapshot), and capturePage (full-page loop writing block-NN-yYYY-theme.png files).

nodes.name: scroll-capture.js (CLI)
nodes.summary: Thin CLI wrapper around lib/scroll-capture.js for one-off visual inspection: captures a page slug or URL in configurable themes/viewport/scroll steps, writing block PNGs and a scroll_capture.json metadata file.

nodes.name: selectors.js
nodes.summary: Selector classification for false-positive filtering: classifies elements as fixed HUD/overlay UI (drawer, search, topics overlays, toggles) by ancestor/id allowlists, and as skippable tags (SVG, canvas, MathJax/KaTeX, Plotly/ECharts); also builds tag+id+class CSS selectors.

nodes.name: isHudElement
nodes.summary: Returns true when a selector or its ancestor matches the FIXED_HUD_ANCESTORS class list or a FIXED_HUD_IDS id, so bug detection and autofix leave deliberate cross-theme UI (drawer, search, topic overlays) untouched.

nodes.name: isSkippableTag
nodes.summary: Returns true for selectors whose base tag is in the skip list (svg, canvas, br, script, ...) or which match MathJax/KaTeX/Plotly/ECharts patterns, since computed color on those elements is misleading.

nodes.name: theme-controller.js
nodes.summary: Puppeteer helpers that drive the blog's theme: toggle html.dark + write the theme cookie + update meta theme-color with a settle delay for MutationObservers, preset the cookie pre-navigation, and query the current theme.

nodes.name: setTheme
nodes.summary: Toggles the html.dark class in the page, writes the theme= light|dark cookie, updates the meta theme-color to #0f172a/#ffffff, and waits settleMs (default 1000) so observers and CSS transitions finish before the next screenshot.

nodes.name: presetCookie
nodes.summary: Sets the theme cookie at the browser level before navigating so a page boots directly in the desired theme instead of flashing the other one.

nodes.name: make-sxs.js
nodes.summary: Generates side-by-side comparison images (light | dark | dark-annotated with red boxes around stuck-white clusters read from _stream.jsonl) using ImageMagick +append, one per captured block per page, into the sxs/ directory.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the darkmode-ci tool: declares pngjs and puppeteer-core dependencies and scripts (test, test:fast, test:single, test:json, capture, fix, fix:dry, fix:critical, fix:all) for the tester, capture CLI, and autofix variants.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for darkmode-ci: explains the three detection modes (theme-switch bugs, stuck-white clusters, WCAG font readability), CLI flags and env vars, autofix workflow, library API, output layout, exit codes, sample CI usage, and the detection-filtering notes (backdrops, indigo accents, img, math/plot, HUD).

nodes.name: test.js
nodes.summary: Main orchestrator CLI: for each of ~60 blog pages, scrolls in steps with a parallel browser-context worker pool, toggles light/dark per block, screenshots + snapshots, runs detectBlock, appends findings to _stream.jsonl, and writes bug_report.json / summary.json with an exit code for CI gating.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a fixed ALL_PAGES slug list of the full course; N async workers share one queue and one launched browser, and white-cluster centers are hit-tested via identifyElementAtPoint to attach element selectors.

nodes.name: testPage
nodes.summary: Per-page test loop: opens an isolated context, navigates, then for each scroll position captures light then dark (screenshot + DOM snapshot), runs detectBlock, hit-tests up to 5 white-cluster centers for element identification, and streams a JSONL record per block.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: parses CLI/env options, launches ScrollCapture, fans the page queue out over `parallel` workers, writes partial.json incrementally plus final bug_report.json and summary.json, prints or emits JSON, and exits 1 when critical/bad font issues, theme bugs, or white clusters exist.

nodes.name: watch-and-fix.js
nodes.summary: Background watcher that polls _stream.jsonl every minute during a live test.js run and spawns `autofix.js --include-stuck-white` whenever the line count crosses a 10-block boundary or the run finishes, giving incremental CSS fixes while the long scan is still in progress.
